events.name: The Offer
events.intro: Rain on one side of the road and ash on the other. Two recruiters have set up on opposite verges. Both have seen you battle. Magma recruiter, Foreman Varrick: "You fight like someone who plans. We need planners. The land's running out, and nobody's doing the maths." Aqua recruiter, Bosun Calla: "You fight like someone with a heart. The sea made every living thing. We're just giving it room." Varrick: "Pay's weekly. The hood's warm." Calla: "Ours comes with a boat." Both hold out a uniform. Between them, the road goes on, empty.

success.text: You join Team Magma as a Recruit. Calla spits. Calla: "We'll remember your face."
You join Team Aqua as a Deckhand. Varrick writes something down.
Both watch you go. The road goes on, and so does Hoenn's story, from the outside.

choices.label: Ask each of them one question.

success.text: To Varrick: "What happens to the people on the coast?" Varrick: "Relocation. It's costed." To Calla: "What happens to the people inland?" Calla: "They'll learn to swim." Both recruiters are a little less sure of themselves.

remembers.notice: Both use your name. "The League likes you. That's worth something to us."
Your rival watches from the trees, and says nothing yet.

events.name: Initiation
events.intro: The base smells of hot stone. A hundred people in the same colour turn round at once. Tabitha: "Hoo hah! Fresh one. Line up. The leader speaks." Maxie, on a gantry, with a pointer: "Sixty-one per cent of this region is water. Useless to anything with feet. I intend to correct the figure." Maxie: "You are not here to believe me. You are here to check my working. Then you'll believe me." He looks at you a moment longer than the rest.

success.text: You salute.
"What's the margin of error?" Maxie is delighted.
The grunt beside you whispers: "First day's the worst. Stick with me."

events.name: The Bunkmate
events.intro: Every recruit gets one. Yours is Grunt Ottoway: a farm boy from a flooded valley. He joined after the river took his family's land. He carries a Numel he's had since it was tiny. Ottoway: "I don't hate water. I hate what it did. Mr. Maxie says there's a difference."

success.text: The Numel watches you do it.

success.text: The fence goes up. Ottoway goes quiet.

failure.text: The fence has a gate, and Granny gets the key. Somebody counts the takings.
